title: How portable-artifacts turns a prompt into a file
subtitle: One small JSON spec in, one offline file out, from any coding agent

sections.title: The model writes a spec; scripts build it
sections.label: The idea
sections.text: Your agent never writes HTML, CSS or video frames. It fills one JSON spec, and deterministic scripts check it and build the file.
points: Five skills: dashboards, diagrams, explainers, 3D scenes and MP4 films.
Every page is one self-contained file that makes no network calls.
The same skills install into Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and Gemini CLI.

sections.title: Every artifact takes the same three moves
sections.label: The loop

items.title: Ask
items.text: Type a prompt such as `/make-dashboard from sales.csv`.

items.title: Spec
items.text: The agent writes a small JSON file; a validator names any bad field and its fix.

items.title: Build
items.text: One command lays it out, renders it and checks it at phone and desktop width.

sections.title: A spec beats freehand output
sections.label: Why a spec

columns.title: Model writes the page
points: Layout drifts from page to page
Easy to pull a font or script from a CDN
Every page needs its own review

columns.title: Model writes a spec
points: Same components and themes every time
Strict CSP: nothing loads from the network
Checked before and after the build

sections.verdict: The spec is short enough to read and diff, and the build is the same on every machine.
